evals.prompt: Tengo este archivo TypeScript de 814 lineas en monolithic/app.ts. Las sesiones de Claude Code son caras y lentas. Como reduzco tokens?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the monolithic file as the main problem, recommends splitting into files of max 150 lines, proposes a concrete split plan, and cites the 18.2% token savings from experiment data.
expectations: Identifies monolithic/app.ts (814 lines) as the primary source of token waste
Recommends a maximum of 150 lines per file as the target
Proposes a concrete split plan with specific file names and responsibilities
Cites the 18.2% token savings figure from experiment data
Mentions noise reduction (92% less noise on focused tasks)

evals.prompt: Mi CLAUDE.md tiene 800 lineas con docs API inline, snippets, y toda la arquitectura. Cada interaccion cuesta demasiados tokens.
evals.expected_output: Recommends keeping CLAUDE.md under 500 lines, explains lazy loading pattern, and mentions 50-70% reduction potential.
expectations: Explains the lazy loading pattern (triggers in CLAUDE.md, details in referenced files)
Suggests moving API docs and architecture details to separate referenced files
Recommends running /context to measure current token usage before and after

evals.prompt: Llevo 2 horas con Claude Code, esta lento, respuestas peores. Tengo 15 MCPs conectados. Que hago?
evals.expected_output: Recommends /clear or /compact for context reset, limiting MCPs to 10 or fewer, using subagents for verbose tasks, and strategic model selection.
expectations: Recommends /clear or /compact to manage accumulated context
Advises limiting active MCPs to 10 or fewer
Suggests using subagents (Task tool) for verbose operations
Mentions strategic model selection (Sonnet for routine, Haiku for simple tasks)
Explains that each unused MCP still costs tokens in tool descriptions
